### testing.find

### testing.visual_diff

**Compare with baseline image**

Compare a PNG screenshot with a baseline PNG pixel by pixel. Reports changed_fraction, changed_bounds and passed (changed_fraction &lt;= threshold); writes a diff image with changes in red when diff is given. update_baseline keeps the actual image as the new baseline instead of comparing.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actual` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of the PNG to check, such as a device.capture result |
| `baseline` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of the approved PNG |
| `diff` | string |  |  | Absolute path for a difference image: the baseline faded, changed pixels red, ignored regions blue |
| `threshold` | number |  | `0` | 0 to 1; Largest changed fraction of the compared pixels that still passes |
| `tolerance` | integer |  | `0` | 0 to 255; A pixel counts as changed when a channel differs by more than this |
| `ignore` | array of object |  |  | up to 100 items; Regions in baseline pixels that are not compared, such as the status bar clock |
| `ignore[].x` | integer | yes |  | at least 0 |
| `ignore[].y` | integer | yes |  | at least 0 |
| `ignore[].width` | integer | yes |  | at least 1 |
| `ignore[].height` | integer | yes |  | at least 1 |
| `update_baseline` | boolean |  | `false` | Copy actual to baseline and compare nothing; only after you have checked the image |

```sh
tomaccoctl call testing.visual_diff '{"actual":"<actual>","baseline":"<baseline>"}'
```

### testing.accessibility

**Check Android accessibility**

Audit an Android screen's UI hierarchy: clickable elements without a label (missing_label), touch targets under min_target_dp (small_target) and text shorter than min_text_height_dp (small_text). Returns structured findings with bounds in pixels and sizes in dp. Heuristics, not a certificate: no contrast, font size or focus order.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string |  |  | non-empty; Android serial from device.list; reads the current screen |
| `hierarchy` | string |  |  | non-empty; Absolute path of a saved android.hierarchy XML instead of a device |
| `density` | number |  |  | 50 to 1000; Screen density in dpi; read from the device when omitted, required with hierarchy |
| `bundle_id` | string |  |  | Audit only this app's elements, leaving out the status bar and other apps |
| `min_target_dp` | number |  | `48` | 1 to 200 |
| `min_text_height_dp` | number |  | `14` | 1 to 100 |
| `report` | string |  |  | Absolute path to also write the result as JSON |

```sh
tomaccoctl call testing.accessibility
```

### testing.crashes

**Find Android crashes**

Read logcat's crash, system and main buffers and return Java crashes (FATAL EXCEPTION), ANRs and native crashes (Fatal signal) as structured events with package, pid, exception, message, stack and reason. Window: since (epoch seconds on the device clock), the life of job_id, or the last lines lines.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Android serial from device.list |
| `bundle_id` | string |  |  | Only events of this app and its processes |
| `since` | number |  |  | at least 0; Only events from this time on, in seconds since 1970 on the device clock |
| `job_id` | string |  |  | Only events while this job ran, such as a project.run or testing.run job; uses the computer's clock, which an emulator shares |
| `lines` | integer |  | `20000` | 1 to 200000; Without since or job_id, how many recent log lines to read |
| `report` | string |  |  | Absolute path to also write the result as JSON |

```sh
tomaccoctl call testing.crashes '{"device":"<device>"}'
```

### testing.results

**Read test results**

Read the JUnit XML results of a project's tests into one summary: totals, suites and each failure with its message and stack. Finds Gradle unit (build/test-results) and instrumented (build/outputs/androidTest-results) results, or reads a given directory or file such as testing.run's junit.xml. since or job_id leaves out results older than the run.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of the project, a results directory or one XML file |
| `since` | number |  |  | at least 0; Leave out files modified before this time, in seconds since 1970 |
| `job_id` | string |  |  | Leave out files older than this job, such as the project.execute test job |
| `report` | string |  |  | Absolute path to also write the summary as JSON |

```sh
tomaccoctl call testing.results '{"path":"<path>"}'
```
